text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky achieves a strong result at the 
Arima Kinen. At the same time, however, 
she feels threatened by Grass Wonder's 
unexpectedly brilliant talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To reaffirm her own strength, she chose 
the Tenno Sho (Spring) as her next race. A 
race where the formidable Special Week 
would also compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving Seiun Sky's side, King Halo, 
having chosen her own path, proudly walked 
away.
